decision: DIFFERS -> W1 (and W3: the page says 'bee balms', Monarda generally, which names the crop's group; the crop is bee balm). iastate_ext powdery-mildew FAQ states "When planting bee balms, select a site that receives at least 6 hours of direct sun each day and space plants 2 to 2½ feet apart." -> in_row [24,30]; no between-rows figure (not_authored). Today's [18,24] overlaps only at 24 and is on no cited page; the NCSU toolbox 'Available Space To Plant: 12 inches-3 feet' is a footprint and does not count (W5). bee-balm leaves the R5 hunt list: a cited page states a figure. The two prose restatements of 18-24 are re-authored.

edits.new: Give plants plenty of room, about 24 to 30 inches apart, when you plant. Space is one of the best ways to prevent the mildew bee balm often gets.
